simple.summary: גָּמוּל (gâmûwl) means Gamul , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 24 17.

definitions.full: H1577. Gamul גָּמוּל proper name, masculine (weaned) a chief of the Levites 1Chr 24:17 . See also גָּמוּל בֵּית ( Jer 48:28 ).
